name: Stendel's Pond
summary: Gnolls prowl Stendel's Pond southwest of Sentinel Hill, where anglers still seek fresh fish.

sections.title: A Dangerous Watering Hole
sections.body: Southwest of Sentinel Hill, Stendel's Pond draws anglers despite the danger along its muddy banks. Gnolls roam nearby, and scattered skeletons with two lone graves show that the shore is perilous. The water may be foul, or the beasts may be to blame, but the cause is unknown. Schools of sagefish still bring anglers to the pond.

faq.answer: Stendel's Pond lies southwest of Sentinel Hill in central Westfall, just off the dusty paths toward the southern reaches.

faq.q: What creatures lurk around the pond?
faq.answer: Territorial Riverpaw gnolls prowl the pond's muddy shore and attack wanderers who approach the water.

faq.q: Why are there skeletons and graves by the shore?
faq.answer: Scattered skeletons and two unnamed graves mark the shore's dangers. The dead may have fallen to gnolls or been poisoned by the pond water, but no one knows for certain.

angles.text: Cooks value the sagefish from these murky waters for their fish dishes.
Near Sentinel Hill, gnoll encampments make the pond an uncontrolled threat on the People's Militia's southern perimeter.
